title: Domain-separate link Schnorr signatures from other single-key profiles
description: Security review found that the canonical link transcript in spec/02-physical-link.md and draft-lichen-link-01 is LENGTH||LLSec||EPO||SEQ||DST_LEN||DST||SIID||PLD with no fixed application-domain tag or digest. LICHEN deliberately reuses one Ed25519/Schnorr key across link frames, announces, gateway coordination, key rotation, DAO origin, SOS, and persistence; several of those profiles sign different raw or CBOR transcripts. DST_LEN only delimits link fields and is described as domain separation, but it does not separate the link protocol from other Schnorr48 applications. This leaves a confused-deputy/cross-profile signature-reuse surface and makes the 128-bit EUF-CMA claim depend on all other signed-message languages remaining disjoint forever. Prefix a versioned fixed link domain (or sign a domain-separated digest), specify the exact bytes, regenerate all link/DIO/timing signatures, and add negative tests proving a valid signature from another Schnorr profile is rejected as a link MIC and vice versa. Coordinate the format change through the rule/protocol version.
notes: Rust complete: exact LICHEN-LINK-v1 NUL domain prefix is prepended to link Schnorr transcript; independent vector preimage and negative legacy/other-profile tests added. Full link vectors/tests pass.
